status: Q1 revision proposal; no scorer or runtime predicate implemented
supersedes: v1 proposal had no replay outcomes; its public-review-only population is withdrawn

timed_stage.name: serial pre-submission pre-commit checks
timed_stage.start: fresh serial check-process entry after oracle work and before commit
timed_stage.end: all selected pre-commit commands return, before a commit object exists
baseline_commands: cue-vet on applicable staged CUE files
timed_stage.exact_expanded_command_arrays: must be frozen at Q1-approved input freeze; no added diff-check baseline
timed_stage.schedule: same fixed serial order in B and N; N appends predicates; no claim about existing parallel hook runtime
timed_stage.invalid: missing applicable checker, skipped required input, index/worktree mismatch, or failed baseline control

baseline.role: reference; execute timed baseline stage and separate frozen mechanical acceptance checks

evaluation.reason: No replay receipts; missing frozen stage/index hashes and controls

reordered.role: original pre-oracle scheduling hypothesis; no experiment is scheduled

evaluation.reason: Supported ceiling 1 defects/1 additions is below 3/2; no replay trials

reordered.wins_if: At least 3 addition-specific defects across at least 2 additions, present before oracle work, with an existing required detector and public bad/fixed pair

new-predicates.role: independent pre-submission hygiene intervention; no inherited reordered checks

predicates.shape: os.environ.get or os.getenv constant fallback rooted in a personal-home or mounted-volume directory; no historical variable-name or literal matching
predicates.diagnostic: repo-relative path, line and rule; omit literal value
predicates.coverage_limit: standard roots, relative/default-free forms and dynamic expressions are not this rule

predicates.scope: staged added/copied/modified index paths under calibration/oracles/
predicates.coverage_limit: deleted paths and filesystem artifacts absent from submitted index do not match

controls.unaffected_control_policy: Freeze exact cleaned revisions, staged paths and index hashes for 13 other additions. Do not assume first-reading or merge snapshots are clean. Nix format, Thrift merge defects and WGSL heading require their repairs; prefer cleaned reference-cutoff tree for other snapshots. Demonstrate B acceptance. A failed control invalidates the frozen run, not a post-result replacement.

new-predicates.scoring: valid complete receipts + all thresholds satisfied => pass/KEEP; valid complete threshold miss => fail/KILL; missing, skipped, invalid or non-isolatable input => indeterminate/NOT_MEASURED

evaluation.reason: No baseline, predicate, repaired-control, benign-control or timing replay has run

scorer_contract.implementation: after Q1 approval only; pure scorer over frozen criteria and immutable case receipts
scorer_contract.existing_infrastructure: reuse ledger JSONL envelope; existing verify does not compute this criterion
scorer_contract.functional_count: distinct defects only; a repeated trial or second bytecode file is not a new defect
scorer_contract.baseline_novelty: N catch counts only when frozen mechanical baseline accepted the same bad case and N rejects it
scorer_contract.control_rule: all 19 frozen controls required; every counted bad case has a passing paired repair; N rejection of any B-passing control is a false blocker
scorer_contract.ledger_trials: minimum paired timing count across all required controls, never sum of subprocesses
scorer_contract.rendering: report, per-arm ledger evaluations and outcome count lines derived by scorer from same criteria/receipt digest
negative_tests: one slow control hidden by pooled median
scorer_contract.invalid_evidence_ledger_policy: Indeterminate/NOT_MEASURED emits diagnostic report only and no claimable ledger row, even with three completed timing pairs. accept_verdict:any is reserved for fully observed pass/fail results.
